docs.title: Architecture Blueprint Kit (Agnostic)
docs.text: Use these prompts and tools to generate C4 (Structurizr), Deployment/Sequence (PlantUML), and Logical (Mermaid) diagrams for any project. Paste outputs into the diagrams/ folder or directly into these pages.

docs.title: Live endpoints
docs.text:
• Open WebUI (Ollama backend): https://ai.shafie.org/
  • Kroki (diagram as a service): not deployed (placeholder was http://localhost:8000)
  • PlantUML server: not deployed (placeholder was http://localhost:18080)

ℹ️ When Kroki or PlantUML go live, update the URLs here and on the Services page.

docs.title: What we’re building
docs.text:
• Self-hosted AI workbench for architecture docs & diagrams
  • Chat + prompt workflows via Open WebUI backed by Ollama
  • MkDocs Material site as the canonical, linkable knowledge base
  • Diagramming:
  • Mermaid (inline in Markdown)
  • (Planned) Kroki for many formats (Mermaid/PlantUML/Graphviz/etc.)
  • (Planned) Dedicated PlantUML server for higher-fidelity UML

docs.title: Stack at a glance
docs.text:
• Docs: MkDocs + Material theme
  • AI: Open WebUI ↔ Ollama (models cached in Docker volume)
  • Reverse proxy / TLS: Nginx + Let’s Encrypt (ai.shafie.org, docs.shafie.org)
  • Infra: Docker Compose

See the Catalog for all architecture packages.

docs.title: Next steps (roadmap)
docs.text:

docs.title: Booking Flow (Sequence)
docs.text:
@startuml
title Booking Flow (Happy Path)

actor User
participant WebApp
participant API
database DB

User -> WebApp : Select mountain & slot
WebApp -> API  : POST /bookings
API   -> DB    : INSERT booking
DB --> API     : OK (id)
API --> WebApp : 201 Created (booking id)
WebApp --> User: Show confirmation + QR
@enduml

docs.title: High-Level Deployment
docs.text:
@startuml
title SMT Deployment (High-Level)

node "User Device" {
  component "Browser" as Browser
  component "iOS App" as IOS
}

node "Edge" {
  artifact "Cloudflare Tunnel / Proxy\nTLS" as Edge
}

node "App Server" {
  component "Frontend (Next.js)" as FE
  component "Backend (Node/Express)" as BE
}

node "Data" {
  database "MySQL" as DB
  component "Redis (cache)" as Cache
}

Browser --> Edge : HTTPS
IOS --> Edge     : HTTPS
Edge --> FE      : HTTP (internal)
FE --> BE        : HTTP (internal)
BE --> DB        : TCP 3306
BE --> Cache     : TCP 6379
@enduml
